name: [MC] Gates
source:
[MC] is taking his first steps into adulthood, enrolling as a first-year student at Vesper University and moving into a new apartment on his own. Life has a lot of surprises for him, but his good-natured attitude and determination to do what's right will help him out as he tries to juggle university, multiple jobs, even more relationships, and—perhaps most importantly—completing the deal he made with Lilith in order to save his immortal soul!

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
